verdict.rationale: Alloy's docs refer to an official SDK, and a separate item mentions a Web SDK with its own changelog, so a first-party SDK exists. Nothing describes its languages, scope, packages or install steps, or shows it being used to build API integrations. The 'Try It!' SDK snippets are generated code samples, not a maintained SDK, so they get no credit. Missing for 10: documented SDK languages and packages, install and usage guides, server-side or API-client SDK coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
